name: Baked Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Pasta

components.name: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Heat oven to 210 C. Mix raw ground turkey with breadcrumbs, egg, onion, garlic, parmesan, herbs and measured seasonings until just blended.
Shape into 20 meatballs of equal raw weight and arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Roast 16-22 minutes until centres reach 74 C.
Meanwhile, simmer onion and garlic in olive oil; add passata, oregano and salt. Reduce gently 10-15 minutes.
Transfer baked meatballs to tomato sauce and heat together briefly.
Portion four meatballs and an even amount of pasta and sauce into each of five containers. Cool rapidly; freeze later-week portions.
